examples.explanation: Both skeletal replacement rules are applied when replacement occurs in the simplified skeleton and in amplificants.
The lower set of heteroatom locants, 2,5 rather than 3,6, is selected.
The primary locant set 1,2,5,7 is lower than 1,4,5,6.
The senior amplificant pyridina receives the lowest possible locant.
Thia is senior to aza in skeletal replacement nomenclature and must receive the lower locant.
When the primary locant sets tie, the composite locant set for the senior oxa prefix selects (I).
The senior replacement prefix oxa receives the lowest locant.

source_text: Part II of phane nomenclature discusses phane parent hydrides substituted by characteristic groups cited as suffixes.
Examples are given for amines, hydroxy compounds, and ketones.
Part II also discusses modification of the degree of hydrogenation.
The topic is more fully developed in Sections P-31.1.6 and P-31.2.3.3.4.
